entries.title: Check that saved changes match success messages (UX-06)
changes: Checked saving and reloading across Faculty Admin, Calendar sessions and instructors, Work Queue reviews, AFC requests and records, SWAP approvals and Teaching Assignments: every success message matched data that stayed after reload.
The Calendar's "teaching sessions in Demo" count now updates right after a session is created or changed, instead of only after a page reload.

entries.title: Show DOE values without misleading defaults (UX-04)
changes: Teaching Summary Credited Hours now show at most two decimals (for example 238.9 instead of 238.90000000000035); missing hours show a dash.
Roles & Appointments no longer says "DOE unavailable" for a value that simply does not exist: it now shows Not mapped, No override or Not calculated, and Needs Review when the final DOE is missing.
Real zero DOE values still show as 0.00%, and a missing contract target still shows Needs Review.
Multi-year Demo shows a missing DOE as a dash instead of 0.00, and a session with no DOE credit as Not recorded instead of 0.
A role that ends partway through a year still counts in full for that year, as agreed with Alex; these cases are handled case by case.
No institutional Beta/SQL/Firestore records or real Faculty identities changed.
Preserve missing session credits through Demo import and assignment editing; reject blank and nonnumeric DOE inputs instead of presenting them as recorded zero.
Remove duplicate Requests and All Approvals buttons from the Calendar toolbar; use the existing sidebar workflows.

entries.title: Restore missing synthetic Course Sessions in PAWS Testing Calendar
changes: Store the 1,937 teaching and 413 CCC synthetic fixtures as compact repeatable test data, retaining all manually changed or deleted synthetic records and existing browser-local work.
Show synthetic teaching sessions in the current browser even if browser storage cannot save, with an explicit persistence warning rather than a misleading empty Calendar.
Display the loaded teaching-session count and update Load Test Data to verify compact persistent storage after a manual import.
Add quota, edited Session, CCC, reload and browser checks; the default Testing calendar must show Fall Week 11 teaching records in the Month view.
No institutional Beta/SQL/Firestore records or real Faculty identities changed.

entries.title: Protect Testing sessions and make synthetic calendar comparison complete
changes: Preserve user-edited legacy Calendar sessions even when an old generated starter ID remains; clean only exact unchanged starter rows.
Show optional synthetic PR #108 teaching and CCC load-test fixtures by default in the isolated browser Testing Demo, without overwriting pre-existing edits or institutional data.
Refresh Compare Weeks after ADC session publication and provide per-week and all-week refresh actions that avoid stale snapshots.
Include weekend sessions in weekly comparisons with explicit Total, Displayed, Check Needed, Filtered Out and Weekend counts.
Add regression tests for data preservation, automatic test fixtures, persistence failure and comparison refresh.

entries.title: Add Beta-density synthetic teaching and CCC load fixtures to PAWS Testing
changes: Added an optional Load Test Data action for Developer, Owner, ADFAD and ADC testers in the browser-local PAWS Calendar.
Created deterministic, fictional Course Session data calibrated to 1,937 teaching sessions and historical Beta weekly density, covering LEC, LAB, SRL, exam and time-review cases.
Added synthetic CCC half-day staffing activities calibrated to 413 assignment slots including 11 Locum, across the May-April academic year.
Preserved browser-local existing/edited records, supporting idempotent additional loads and PR #107's empty Calendar startup.
No real Beta/SQL/Firestore source data, Faculty identities, or production systems were changed.

entries.title: Testing Calendar comparison, empty start and team Work Queues
changes: Added a Testing-only Compare Weeks view where users can add any available Spring, Fall or Winter week, including nonconsecutive Fall and Winter weeks, and stack calendars vertically.
Each selected week has its own top-right X to remove only that week; the normal Week grid layout, session details and calendar colors are reused.
Added Sort weeks with Custom, Earliest to latest and Latest to earliest modes for nonconsecutive Spring/Fall/Winter week cards.
Authorized Demo administrators can move each selected comparison week up or down using accessible arrow buttons; moves switch to Custom order and do not change saved schedules or DOE.
Fetches authorized session data independently for each selected week and keeps results scoped to the current Demo identity.
Existing Year, Course, Activity type, Search and My Timetable filters apply; comparison does not export or bulk-edit a different calendar range.

Added unit and staged browser tests for Fall Week 1 versus Winter Week 5, repeat selection, unlimited card count, loading and individual removal. The feature is browser-local Testing only, with no Beta, SQL or DOE changes.

Removed automatically generated starter Course Sessions from the browser-local Calendar and disabled the default University Closure overlay; existing saved starter rows are removed by exact fixture ID while preserving user-created imports and drafts.
ADC starts with a Schedule Workflow import task; after an ADC draft or publication, role-scoped outstanding tasks route LAB to Lab Scheduling and ADFAD to its Faculty assignment Work Queue.
Unified Work Queue shortcuts for ADC, LAB, ADFAD and other authorized Demo roles with live task counts and status; no real university data or production permissions are changed.

Stopped automatic 2027–28 sample-year generation and removed its public sample-loading shortcut. Only untouched auto-generated example Courses are cleared from previously saved browser Demo years; manually edited year data stays intact.

entries.title: One-click eligible annual Role confirmations in the Testing Demo
changes: Added an ADFAD-only Confirm All Eligible Drafts action to Academic Year Workspace Roles, with counts for eligible, skipped, and previously confirmed records.
Approved valid partial-year rollover renewals with an explicit ADFAD action, while skipping inactive, ineligible, future-start, missing, and out-of-year records.
Kept existing per-role confirmation available for valid Roles, added stale-selection validation and one auditable batch action across all rows (including beyond the first 200).
Preserved current Teaching, Course, DOE and browser-local saved data; this feature is Testing Demo only, not a Beta/SQL bulk write.

entries.title: Fix Academic Year Demo publication blockers and ineligible Faculty corrections
changes: Show the affected Faculty member, Session, date and topic alongside each ineligible instructor publication blocker.
Add a targeted replacement/removal control in Publish Review that preserves other assignments and DOE credit and requires a new ADFAD Finalize.
Prevent new inactive/ineligible Faculty assignments while retaining the future-activation date checks.
Treat unassigned and legacy null instructor placeholders as warnings rather than incorrectly blocking them as inactive Faculty.
Display DOE impact with two decimal places without modifying calculation rules or prior published data.
This change is limited to synthetic browser-local PAWS Testing data; existing saved browser work is preserved, and PAWS Beta is unchanged.

entries.title: One floating Teaching Lists window for CCC, VISC and HICC–CC in Testing
changes: Combined the separate CCC Schedule, VISC List and HICC–CC List links into one Teaching sidebar entry and large three-tab floating window.
Preserved CCC yearly search and Refresh, and VISC/HICC–CC directory sorting, status filters and authorized read-only data.
Added one Close control, Escape and outside-click closing, keyboard tab navigation, focus return and account-switch cleanup.
Reused the existing CCC and leadership endpoints without changing permissions, saved records, teaching calculations or DOE.
This is a synthetic PAWS Testing Frontend Demo UI change only; Beta and University data remain unchanged.

entries.title: LAB animal resource requests and horse/Pet Professor booking warnings in Testing
changes: Added a Resource Request step before Student Groups in Lab Scheduling for synthetic Horse and Pet Professor requests, with required Reserve Notes.
Tracks 38 synthetic horses individually; Owner/Developer confirmation rejects assignments that overlap or violate a minimum 24-hour rest window after previous use.
Shows an in-app warning when requested/confirmed Pet Professor demand exceeds 30 within a rolling 48 hours; the warning does not block requests.
Added per-Course authorized LAB request history, version/replay checks, synthetic confirmation/rejection and adjustable resource settings.
No real resource bookings, staff notifications, production animal records, canonical timetable or DOE changes; functionality is Testing-only.
New ADC-published LAB Sessions must submit Reserve Notes or explicitly choose no animals before Single Activity or Bulk CSV group publication; legacy sessions remain compatible.

entries.title: Lab group scheduling and publication in the Testing Demo
changes: ADC-only Schedule Workflow publishes single or CSV/TSV bulk Course Sessions; Developer and Owner retain full testing access.
Every ADC publication immediately generates LAB tasks for LAB Sessions and ADFAD Faculty tasks for all Session types, including cases without suggested Faculty.
LAB and ADFAD now have separate office Work Queue panels and prefilled downloadable CSV templates for their assigned Sessions.
LAB bulk upload records rooms, capacity, run times and mandatory student groups/rosters; preview blocks collisions and invalid staffing-free lab allocations.
ADFAD bulk upload records confirmed Faculty, teaching roles and credited hours, and runs AFC, appointment, work-activity and cross-session conflict checks.
LAB/ADFAD office batches validate in an isolated store and publish atomically only when all rows pass, using revision checks and idempotent Batch IDs.
ADFAD can view and download work immediately after ADC publish; LAB Sessions show Waiting for LAB until operational group publication is complete.
Role-based office scopes restrict LAB roster access; public Calendar displays published rooms/groups and confirmed instructors, never private student identities.
Developer Dashboard keeps editable versioned ADC import rules and optional-field task ownership; four core publication fields stay required.
All changes remain browser-local PAWS Testing Demo only; PAWS Beta, production SQL and real rosters are unchanged.
Orange T badges now identify the new ADC schedule workflow, LAB scheduling, LAB/ADFAD work queues, Developer rule controls, CSV bulk imports and workflow tasks while Testing acceptance is pending.
Combined the LAB bulk Work Queue with Lab Scheduling under Single Activity / Bulk CSV tabs; removed the standalone LAB queue button without removing office import, validation or publishing behavior.

entries.title: 2027–28 synthetic Courses, Sessions and Faculty assignment examples
changes: The PAWS Testing Academic Year workspace now includes 2027–28 sample data: 3 Courses, 9 Working Sessions, 5 Published Sessions and fictional demo Faculty assignments.
Examples include a Published Course, another Course awaiting Publish Changes, and a Draft-only Course for testing approval and Faculty visibility.
One synthetic 2028 AFC overlap demonstrates conflict review; 2027–28 DOE stays Pending until its annual rules and results are published.
Existing browser-local 2027–28 Courses are not overwritten. Owners can load the example into an already-created empty year using Load 2027–28 Sample Data.
Sample data remain entirely in the browser-local Testing Demo and do not modify 2026–27 records, live SQL, Firestore or University Faculty information.

entries.title: Add recent feature updates to the homepage Change Log
changes: The homepage Change Log now includes concise summaries of AFC changes, SWAP approvals, the All Approvals queue, movable Testing controls and PAWS Beta-style Testing pages from recent merged PRs.
The history clearly separates Testing-only functionality from live University data, and excludes infrastructure-only PRs and unmerged features.

entries.title: Future Faculty activation, public Change Log and Markdown documentation cleanup
changes: Faculty Lookup: add a new Faculty member, set a future activation date, and distinguish Pending Start from manually inactive staff.
Calendar and Teaching Assignments: prevent assignments before the Faculty member's activation date while allowing eligible future sessions.
Add a large Change Log window on the PAWS homepage with an Open button and a Close button.
Require every future PR to describe its updates in the Change Log; agents must follow the repository rules and CI validates the record.
These features use synthetic browser-local Testing data; no live SQL or Firestore records are modified.

Reviewed all 198 Markdown documents and removed 36 redundant or superseded Beta freeze, release and reconciliation notes; preserved security, design, migration and acceptance evidence in active files and Git history.
Updated the Testing setup and documentation index and corrected historical Firebase/Azure references so old deployment instructions cannot be mistaken for the active Demo route.

entries.title: AFC date changes and clearer withdrawal history
changes: Faculty can request new dates for an approved AFC. The original dates remain in effect until the revised request is approved.
ADFAD can edit approved AFC dates directly; authorized administrators can also correct dates on manual or imported AFC records.
Updated Withdraw and Withdrawn wording in AFC records and history.
Date changes check request versions and teaching coverage, and keep a before-and-after change history.

entries.title: Multi-year Planning, Course rollover and Publish Review in PAWS Testing
changes: Added Academic Year selection in Calendar, Faculty Dashboard and Teaching Assignments, with Planning, Review, Active and Archived phases.
Owners can create an empty next year; authorized staff can preview and selectively copy previous Published Courses, sessions, eligible instructors and schedules.
Added per-Course Working and Published versions, Publish Review with conflicts and DOE impact, and Publish Changes.
Added annual DOE rule and result release, internal Working DOE comparison, manual Override review, and automatic recalculation after published changes.
Added annual role renewal, cross-year Teaching and DOE comparison, Owner archival and restoration, and frozen historical conflicts.
New-year Faculty assignments and role renewals respect future Faculty activation dates.
Testing-only browser-local data: legacy 2026-27 Calendar is masked on other years; no live SQL or Firestore data is changed.

entries.title: Restore final SWAP approval in the Testing site
changes: Fixed a DOE preview issue that could leave Approve & apply to timetable disabled for an authorized ADFA-stage SWAP request.
Final SWAP approval can now update the assigned Faculty in the synthetic Testing timetable.

entries.title: Actionable approvals and movable Testing panels
changes: All Approvals now supports authorized AFC recommendations, approvals and rejections, plus stage-specific SWAP Approve, Reject and Push Back actions.
Final SWAP timetable changes and DOE-sensitive transfers still require the full request review and appropriate permissions.
The Test Site banner and Demo Role Tester can be moved or collapsed, with their display preferences kept across page navigation.
Replaced remaining visible VISTA labels with PAWS.

entries.title: Use PAWS Beta-style pages on the Testing website
changes: The shared Testing website now presents the PAWS Beta-style Calendar, Faculty/Admin and Teaching Assignments pages.
Testing-only features are identified with a T badge.
All browser Testing workflows still use synthetic, local demo data rather than live University SQL or Firestore records.

entries.title: Bring Beta features into the PAWS Testing codebase
changes: Imported the Beta Calendar, Faculty, Teaching Assignments, AFC, SWAP, CCC, DOE and reporting application modules and related APIs.
This was a code migration, not a live feature release. PR #91 subsequently switched the shared Testing website to these Beta-style pages using synthetic data.
